mentions.name: Social battery pin badges
mentions.description: Electronic pin badges that display a social battery/mood, which the author makes and sells; the product range is being expanded with seasonal versions such as a Christmas mood badge and an upcoming Halloween-themed ghost badge.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been making and selling my electronic social battery pin badges for a while now (https://hortus.dev/products/social-battery) and I'm expanding the range with seasonal versions like a Christmas mood badge, and a halloween themed ghost badge that's coming soon.
